methods.name: public static LocaleListCompat getSystemLocales(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment:
* Returns the current system locales, ignoring app-specific overrides. * *

Note: Apps should generally access the user's locale preferences as indicated in * their in-process {@link android.os.LocaleList}s. However, in case an app-specific locale * is set, this method helps cater to rare use-cases which might require specifically knowing * the system locale.

methods.name: public static LocaleListCompat getApplicationLocales(@NonNull Context context)
methods.comment:
* Returns application locales for the calling app as a {@link LocaleListCompat}. This API * for non-{@link androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate} context to easily get the per-app * locale on the prior API 33 devices. * *

Returns a {@link LocaleListCompat#getEmptyLocaleList()} if no app-specific locales are * set.

methods.name: private static Object getLocaleManagerForApplication(Context context)
methods.comment: * Returns the localeManager for the current application.
